SUN.name: Sun
SUN.insight: The Sun symbolizes identity, purpose and the wish to express yourself.

MOON.name: Moon
MOON.insight: The Moon symbolizes emotional needs, familiar habits and what feels comforting.

MERCURY.name: Mercury
MERCURY.insight: Mercury symbolizes learning, reasoning and the exchange of ideas.

VENUS.name: Venus
VENUS.insight: Venus symbolizes affection, attraction and what you value or enjoy.

MARS.name: Mars
MARS.insight: Mars symbolizes initiative, desire and the way you assert yourself.

JUPITER.name: Jupiter
JUPITER.insight: Jupiter symbolizes growth through exploration, belief and a search for meaning.

SATURN.name: Saturn
SATURN.insight: Saturn symbolizes boundaries, responsibility and what takes time to build.

URANUS.name: Uranus
URANUS.insight: Uranus symbolizes independence, experimentation and breaks with familiar patterns.

NEPTUNE.name: Neptune
NEPTUNE.insight: Neptune symbolizes imagination, longing and the blurred line between ideals and illusion.

PLUTO.name: Pluto
PLUTO.insight: Pluto symbolizes power, control and profound processes of change.

CHIRON.name: Chiron
CHIRON.insight: Chiron symbolizes vulnerability and the understanding that can grow from difficult experiences.

CERES.name: Ceres
CERES.insight: Ceres symbolizes nurturing, nourishment and the experience of giving or receiving care.

NORTH_NODE.name: North Node
NORTH_NODE.insight: The North Node marks the point where the Moon crosses the Sun’s apparent path northward, interpreted here as a symbol of development.

SOUTH_NODE.name: South Node
SOUTH_NODE.insight: The South Node marks the point where the Moon crosses the Sun’s apparent path southward, interpreted here as a symbol of familiar patterns.

EARTH.name: Earth
EARTH.insight: Earth is shown here as a symbolic point opposite the Sun, rather than a planet observed from Earth.

ASCENDANT_SYMBOL.name: Ascendant
ASCENDANT_SYMBOL.insight: The Ascendant is where the zodiac meets the eastern horizon, symbolizing how you first meet the world.

MIDHEAVEN.name: Midheaven
MIDHEAVEN.insight: The Midheaven marks the zodiac’s upper meridian crossing and symbolizes vocation and public visibility.

DESCENDANT.name: Descendant
DESCENDANT.insight: The Descendant is where the zodiac meets the western horizon, symbolizing encounters and partnerships.

IMUM_COELI.name: Imum Coeli
IMUM_COELI.insight: The Imum Coeli is the point opposite the Midheaven, symbolizing home, roots and private foundations.

aries.name: Aries
aries.insight: Aries symbolizes the impulse to begin, take a risk and act directly.

taurus.name: Taurus
taurus.insight: Taurus symbolizes steadiness, physical comfort and the patient cultivation of what matters.

gemini.name: Gemini
gemini.insight: Gemini symbolizes curiosity, conversation and the exploration of different perspectives.

cancer.name: Cancer
cancer.insight: Cancer symbolizes emotional attachment, protection and the need for belonging.

leo.name: Leo
leo.insight: Leo symbolizes creative expression, generosity and the wish to be seen.

virgo.name: Virgo
virgo.insight: Virgo symbolizes careful observation, practical service and the refinement of skills.

libra.name: Libra
libra.insight: Libra symbolizes cooperation, fairness and the weighing of different needs.

scorpio.name: Scorpio
scorpio.insight: Scorpio symbolizes emotional depth, questions of trust and the process of letting go.

ophiuchus.name: Ophiuchus
ophiuchus.insight: Ophiuchus is a constellation crossed by the Sun’s apparent path and included in this app’s True Sky preset.

sagittarius.name: Sagittarius
sagittarius.insight: Sagittarius symbolizes exploration, the search for meaning and the testing of beliefs.

capricorn.name: Capricorn
capricorn.insight: Capricorn symbolizes responsibility, patient ambition and work toward lasting goals.

aquarius.name: Aquarius
aquarius.insight: Aquarius symbolizes independent thought, collective ideals and alternatives to established ways.

pisces.name: Pisces
pisces.insight: Pisces symbolizes imagination, compassion and openness to experiences beyond clear boundaries.

Conjunction.name: Conjunction
Conjunction.insight: A conjunction places two chart factors near the same zodiac position, symbolically combining their themes.

Semisextile.name: Semisextile
Semisextile.insight: A semisextile places two chart factors about 30° apart, interpreted here as a subtle need to accommodate differences.

Sextile.name: Sextile
Sextile.insight: A sextile places two chart factors about 60° apart, symbolizing opportunities for cooperation.

Square.name: Square
Square.insight: A square places two chart factors about 90° apart, symbolizing friction between themes that call for attention.

Trine.name: Trine
Trine.insight: A trine places two chart factors about 120° apart, symbolizing ease and mutual support.

Quincunx.name: Quincunx
Quincunx.insight: A quincunx places two chart factors about 150° apart, symbolizing themes that can be difficult to reconcile.

Opposition.name: Opposition
Opposition.insight: An opposition places two chart factors about 180° apart, symbolizing contrasting needs held in relationship.

1.insight: The first house represents self-presentation, physical presence and how you enter new situations.

2.insight: The second house represents personal resources, possessions and what you rely on for security.

3.insight: The third house represents everyday learning, communication, siblings and nearby surroundings.

4.insight: The fourth house represents home, family roots and the foundations of private life.

5.insight: The fifth house represents creativity, play, romance and relationships with children.

6.insight: The sixth house represents daily work, practical responsibilities and routines of care.

7.insight: The seventh house represents one-to-one commitments, including partnerships and agreements.

8.insight: The eighth house represents shared resources, obligations and experiences of loss or change.

9.insight: The ninth house represents higher learning, travel and the beliefs that shape a wider worldview.

10.insight: The tenth house represents vocation, reputation and responsibilities in public life.

11.insight: The eleventh house represents friendships, groups and hopes pursued with others.

12.insight: The twelfth house represents solitude, retreat and parts of life kept out of public view.

settings.help.faganBradley.text: The preset labeled Vedic uses twelve equal signs with the Fagan–Bradley sidereal reference, a Western sidereal convention distinct from those commonly used in Vedic astrology.

settings.help.tropical.text: Tropical astrology divides the zodiac into twelve equal signs, beginning at the March equinox point.

settings.help.trueSkyConstellations.text: True Sky uses unequal, constellation-based divisions following the Chimenti convention, including Ophiuchus as a thirteenth sign.

settings.houses.placidusHint.text: Houses sized by the time it takes each part of the sky to rise.

settings.houses.wholeSignHint.text: Each house is one whole sign.
